privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.lead: The protection of your personal data is important to us. Below we inform you about the processing of your data in accordance with the revised Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (revFADP) and, where applicable, the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

sections.heading: Controller
sections.body: The controller responsible for data processing is Elias Solutions GmbH, Solothurnerstrasse 2, 4614 Hägendorf, Switzerland. For questions about data protection, you can reach us at contact@elias-solutions.ch.

sections.heading: What data we process
sections.body: When you visit our website, technically necessary data (e.g. IP address, date and time of access, pages visited) are processed by our hosting provider. When you use our contact or application form, we process the data you provide (name, email address, company, and your message or, for applications, the selected position and your description).

sections.heading: Contact and application form
sections.body: To send the messages submitted via the forms, we use the service EmailJS (EmailJS, USA) as a processor. The data you enter is transmitted to EmailJS servers and may be processed in the USA. We use this data solely to handle your enquiry or application. The legal basis is your consent as well as our legitimate interest in communicating with interested parties and applicants.

sections.heading: Hosting
sections.body: Our website is operated by a hosting provider that processes the data on our behalf. Server log files are created to ensure secure and stable operation.

sections.heading: Cookies and local storage
sections.body: We do not use tracking cookies. For the functionality of the website, we store your language and display preference (light/dark) locally in your browser (localStorage). This data remains on your device and is not transmitted to us.

sections.heading: Disclosure to third parties
sections.body: Your data is only disclosed to the processors engaged to provide our services (e.g. hosting, EmailJS) or where we are legally required to do so. Your data is not sold.

sections.heading: Retention
sections.body: We retain your data only for as long as necessary for the stated purposes or due to statutory retention obligations. Application documents are deleted after the recruitment process is completed, unless you have consented to longer retention.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You have the right to access, rectification, erasure and restriction of the processing of your personal data, as well as the right to data portability and objection. You can withdraw consent at any time. To do so, contact contact@elias-solutions.ch. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the competent data protection authority (in Switzerland, the FDPIC).

sections.heading: Changes
sections.body: We may amend this privacy policy to reflect changes in the legal framework or in our services. The current version published on this website applies.
